title: Hybrid test - fall park

pain.statement: Photographers want to spend the day shooting, but bookings, contracts, payments and gallery follow-ups pull them back to the desk and spread across separate tools.

evidence.summary: Guide describes booking sessions in one app and delivering galleries in another, the stitched-together setup many photographers run.
News piece (Sep 2023): a photographer's video about phoning clients over unpaid invoices drew millions of views and many photographers said the same.
Photography business article on chasing invoice payments well past 60 days.
A gallery vendor explains pairing its galleries with a separate client-management tool, so the workflow lives in two products.
